figures.label: S2
figures.caption: Figure S2. Scatter plots showing the predictive performance of the coGN/coNGN models specifically for sulfur-containing compounds. These data correspond to the subset of entries in Figure S1 that include sulfur in their composition. Predicted versus DFT-calculated values are shown for Eform (eV/atom), Egap(eV), GVRH (log(GPa)), and KVRH (log(GPa)). The results demonstrate that sulfur-containing systems do not exhibit systematically larger errors compared to the full dataset, despite the model being trained on an oxide-dominated MP dataset.

figures.label: S3
figures.caption: Figure S3. Distribution of space groups among the 50 structures with the largest prediction errors in GVRH. The error-dominated samples span multiple cubic, hexagonal, trigonal, and monoclinic symmetries (e.g., Pm-3m, Fm-3m, I4/mmm, Fd-3m, R-3, C2/m), with no occurrence of the LGPS-type tetragonal space group (P4₂/nmc). This indicates that the model’s largest errors are not concentrated in space groups, supporting that the elastic-modulus predictions do not exhibit structural bias against LGPS-type materials.
